references.title: Envy-Free Cake Divisions Cannot Be Found by Finite Protocols
references.locator: Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 15(1), R11, published 7 January 2008. Abstract and §§1–2 read in full. Impossibility concerns complete connected allocations; distinguishes queried marks from final physical cuts, and finite termination from a uniform query bound.

references.title: A Discrete and Bounded Envy-Free Cake Cutting Protocol for Any Number of Agents
references.locator: Author version v12, 27 August 2017, of FOCS 2016 work. Full abstract, Introduction results and Robertson–Webb model paragraphs read. Distinguishes complete allocation, partial exact-proportional allocation, and connected partial allocation with only a 1/(3n) share guarantee.

references.title: Cutting Down the Tower: Single-Exponential Envy-Free Cake Cutting
references.locator: 4 September 2026 preprint. Full abstract, Introduction through Theorem 1.1, and §2 read; reports a deterministic complete-allocation n^{O(1)}2^n Robertson–Webb query bound for nonatomic additive valuations. Proofs not independently verified. Its output may be disconnected.

references.title: Exact Cut Complexity of Equal-Length Proportional Cake Cutting
references.locator: MFCS 2026, Article 34, published 21 August 2026. Full abstract and opening introduction read. Its exact 2n−2 bound concerns existential equal-length proportional division; it is not a bound for finite general envy-free protocols.
